author: capricorniaxd
body:
Puesto has a location near the Anaheim Convention Center. In my limited experience, I would consider Puesto to be somewhat upscale Mexican food. There's a great variety of drinks and dishes to try. I have taken a group to this restaurant after a conference and we ate our weight in tortilla chips and roasted salsa.

The interior is quite spacious so I'm sure they would be able to accommodate a large group with a reservation.
